component.name: JackHack96 Easy Effects Presets
component.summary: A varied collection of presets to configure Easy Effects

description.p: Output presets for Easy Effects, including equalizer curves (Perfect EQ, Boosted), bass enhancing presets based on the Razor Surround impulse responses, loudness and auto gain presets for laptop speakers, Dolby Atmos-inspired and Speaker Sync presets.
A library of additional impulse responses for the Convolver effect is also included.
Added the Dolby Atmos and Speaker Sync presets and low-latency impulse responses.
